about: Luma (lu.ma / luma.com) event discovery: search public events by city, category or keyword, browse community calendars, and get event details, dates, venues and URLs through Luma's JSON API.

commands.summary: List or keyword-search upcoming public events in a Luma city (default San Francisco) or a category such as ai/tech, with dates, area and event URL slug

params.name: placeId
params.description: Discover place id (city). San Francisco is discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka; other ids come from list-places. Omit when searching a category via --slug.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword to search event names, e.g. AI, hackathon, agents

params.name: slug
params.description: Category slug (from list-categories), e.g. ai, tech. Use with --latitude/--longitude to center results.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Category id, e.g. cat-ai (alternative to --slug)

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude to center category results, e.g. 37.7749 for San Francisco

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude to center category results, e.g. -122.4194 for San Francisco

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's next_cursor

commands.summary: List upcoming or past events of a community calendar (e.g. an SF AI meetup group), optionally filtered by tag or keyword

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id (cal-...). Get it from resolve-url with the calendar's URL slug, or from list-place-calendars

params.name: period
params.description: Upcoming or past events

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword search within the calendar, e.g. hackathon

params.name: tagId
params.description: Calendar tag id to filter by (tag-...)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's next_cursor

commands.summary: Get full details of one event: name, start/end time, timezone, venue/address info, location type, host calendar and URL slug

params.name: eventId
params.description: Event id (evt-...) from search-events or list-calendar-events

commands.summary: Resolve a luma.com URL slug (city like sf, category like ai, calendar like genai-sf, or event slug) to its kind and ids plus embedded data

params.name: url
params.description: Path slug after luma.com/, e.g. sf, ai, sf-hackersquad

commands.summary: List Luma discovery categories (AI, Tech, Crypto, ...) with slugs, ids and upcoming event counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max categories (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get a category page (e.g. ai, tech): description, event count and featured timeline calendars such as conference side-event calendars

params.name: slug
params.description: Category slug, e.g. ai, tech

commands.summary: List featured community calendars (organizer groups) for a city, with slug, description and website

params.name: placeId
params.description: Discover place id; San Francisco is discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka

commands.summary: List a calendar's events with name, start time, coordinates and full luma.com event URL (href)

params.name: calendarId
params.description: Calendar id (cal-...)

params.name: period
params.description: Upcoming or past events

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max events (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: List a city's events inside a map bounding box (north/south/east/west) with name, start time and coordinates

params.name: placeId
params.description: Discover place id; San Francisco is discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka

params.name: north
params.description: North latitude of box

params.name: south
params.description: South latitude of box

params.name: east
params.description: East longitude of box

params.name: west
params.description: West longitude of box

commands.summary: Get a discovery city's details: name, slug, description, timezone, event count and featured event ids

params.name: placeId
params.description: Discover place id; San Francisco is discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka

commands.summary: List Luma discovery cities (nearest first) with place ids, slugs and event counts

params.name: featuredPlaceId
params.description: Place id to feature first, e.g. discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka (San Francisco)

commands.summary: List major featured calendars on the Luma homepage (e.g. tech/climate weeks) with dates and slugs
